description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I: Jack v2] and [Samurai Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I: Jack v2
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Vermillion Tranquility after using Samurai abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II: Jack v2] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II: Jack v2
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Samurai abilities, casts Dual Zealous Counter after using Samurai abilities

description.name: Dual Zealous Counter
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 30% (15s) to all allies with 0-3 Samurai allies in the party, Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] to the target and grants [ATK and MND +15%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)] to all allies with 4+ Samurai allies in the party

description.name: ATK and MND +15%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)
description.text: ATK and MND +15%, DEF and RES +25%

description.name: Vermillion Tranquility
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the same row

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
